summary: Iteration 2 testing (report + reminder + officials rename/reset/soft-delete + calendar picker + officials search). Backend: 41/41 pytest cases pass. Report endpoint returns correct confirmed/present/absent counts + officials list; 403 for officials verified. Officials rename regenerates username (m.cognome), password reset works (new login 200), soft-delete removes user from GET /officials and blocks login. Reminder notifications fire when today >= start_date-1 and are idempotent per competition (reminder_sent flag prevents duplicates on repeat GETs). Frontend: master login → competition-form → DatePickerField (comp-start / comp-end) opens Italian calendar (Gennaio…Dicembre, Lun-first grid), tapping cal-day-N fills the field, save creates the competition (verified 'TEST_CalendarGara' with '15 set 2026 → 20 set 2026' on master dashboard). officials.tsx search-officials input filters list live by name/username; clear-search resets. competition/[id] open-report navigates to competition-report showing 3-stat card row + share-report button. TWO REAL BACKEND ISSUES surfaced: (1) HIGH — soft-deleted usernames block re-creation & rename because create_official / update_official check db.users.find_one({username}) without filtering deleted_at, so a master who deletes and re-adds the same person gets a 409 forever. (2) HIGH — ensure_reminders_sent() sets reminder_sent=True unconditionally after processing, even if the confirmed list was empty at that moment. Any GET on /notifications, /notifications/unread-count, or /competitions that hits the reminder window BEFORE any official is confirmed will permanently disable reminders for that competition. Reproduced deterministically under parallel pytest execution. Deprecated packages: none found (already migrated to expo-video/expo-audio family, using @react-native-vector-icons/ionicons, react-native-keyboard-controller). RN-Web warning: 'shadow* is deprecated. Use boxShadow.' still present on FAB/segment styles (cosmetic).

critical.issue: Soft-deleted usernames block re-creation and rename. Uniqueness check does not filter deleted_at=None, so after DELETE the same 'first-initial.surname' pair is forever unusable. Fix: add {'deleted_at': None} to the find_one filter, or hard-delete when re-adding.

reminder_sent is set to True even when the confirmed list is empty at fire time. If any endpoint that calls ensure_reminders_sent (GET /notifications, /notifications/unread-count, /competitions) runs after request_sent=True but BEFORE the master confirms officials — and today >= start_date-1 — the flag is latched and reminders are permanently lost for that competition. Fix: only set reminder_sent=True when at least one push_notification was actually sent, or key the flag per (competition_id, official_id).

issues: DatePickerField field text order: the clear (X) icon sits after the placeholder/value — on very long formatted dates the value can push it out on ultra-narrow screens; consider fixed width for the clear button or trailing icon container.

react_native_issues.issue: RN-Web console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(master)/officials.tsx:239-243 (fab) and /app/frontend/app/competition/[id].tsx:397 (segActive).

Console warning during modal open: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing'. Web-only side-effect from the Modal fade animation in DatePickerField.tsx:102 (animationType="fade"). Consider animationType="none" on web or wrap in Platform.select to silence.
RN-Web warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Triggered by React Native Modal internals; safe to ignore until upstream RN Web patch.

action_items: HIGH: In server.py create_official + update_official uniqueness checks, filter {'deleted_at': None} so soft-deleted usernames can be reused.

HIGH: In server.py ensure_reminders_sent(), guard the reminder_sent=True update behind 'len(confirmed) > 0' OR mark reminders per availability (add reminder_sent to availabilities and check per row). Otherwise a race between availability request auto-dispatch and confirm leaves no reminder.
OPTIONAL: migrate shadow* -> boxShadow on fab + segActive styles to clean RN-Web warnings.
OPTIONAL: set Modal animationType='none' on web in DatePickerField to suppress useNativeDriver warning.
critical_code_review_comments: DatePickerField is clean, self-contained, uses locale-correct Italian month/weekday labels, exposes cal-prev/cal-next/cal-day-N testIDs — good testability.
competition-report.tsx correctly guards for empty officials list and uses formatDateRange + Share.share; renders 3 stat pills with strong color contrast.
officials.tsx uses useMemo for filtered list — efficient; both add-official-header and add-official-fab route to same form, good.
server.py report endpoint returns only confirmed officials (server-side filter), computes present/absent counts server-side — clean, no client math required.

make_username uses first_name[0].lower() + '.' + surname.lower().replace(' ', '') — works for compound surnames without spaces but strips spaces in multi-word surnames (e.g. 'De Rossi' -> 'derossi'). Acceptable given the spec, worth confirming with the product owner.

Reminder assertion is race-sensitive under xdist — the current pytest run passed because TestReportAndReminder finishes on one worker before parallel /competitions polling latches reminder_sent, but this is not a stable guarantee in production.
rca_of_issue: Bug 1 (soft-delete blocks re-add): create_official and update_official run db.users.find_one({'username': username}) without a deleted_at filter. Soft-delete only sets deleted_at + active=False, leaving the username row indexed with the old value. Any subsequent attempt to reuse that username returns 409. Repro: create Luca Bianchi -> DELETE -> re-POST same payload -> 409. Fix: filter by {'deleted_at': None} in the uniqueness check, and/or free the username on soft-delete (e.g. rename to '<uuid>_l.bianchi'). Bug 2 (reminder latches to empty): ensure_reminders_sent() runs on every /notifications, /notifications/unread-count, and /competitions GET. It fetches confirmed availabilities and unconditionally updates reminder_sent=True at the end, even when 0 notifications were pushed. Repro: create competition with start_date=today, immediately have any endpoint call ensure_reminders_sent (auto-triggered by frontend polling) BEFORE the master confirms an official. reminder_sent becomes True, subsequent confirmations never trigger the reminder. Fix: (a) only set reminder_sent=True when at least one reminder was pushed, OR (b) track reminders per availability row so confirmations after the window still get a reminder.
